description: This PHP source file handles various AJAX requests related to wireless network configuration, including saving settings, WPS setup, enabling/disabling radios, MAC filtering, and pairing clients. It processes JSON input, performs configuration changes via setStr calls, and outputs JSON responses.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID by calculating the apply ID and RF index, then invoking configuration commands.
